shown.message:
The GNN baseline is now in the paper, pushed to `dev` and `candidate-draft-12`. I recomputed every GNN figure from `gnn_cells.csv` and they match `experiment-repo`'s report. My local build keeps the main text within 9 pages, but I have not checked the official `document` build.

- **Where it appears:**
  - the design section describes the network;
  - a sentence in Section 5.2 reports it;
  - a new appendix paragraph gives the full numbers;
  - the Limitations line says one small network was run on 13 cells.
  - The "not run" sentence in the design section now mentions only causal message passing.
- **Result stated:** the network is the best learner, but its RMSE exceeds the regression's in 66 of 91 cell–mechanism rows (paired interval above zero) and is smaller in 5, all on the threshold mechanism (d).
- **Caveats stated:** one architecture, untuned; 50 draws; the SBM d=80, p=0.25 cell is absent; not run on Tier G or the cluster designs.
- **Page fit:** the appendix paragraph does not count toward the 9 pages, but the main-text additions did. I cut the n and p exponents of the leverage scaling, the post-hoc detail for mechanism (e), and a "Figure 4 shows bias and SD separately" sentence, and reduced two figures to 0.85 and 0.9 of the text width. Main text now ends on page 9 with References beginning on the same page, so the earlier "References on page 10" check no longer applies.
- **Open:** I asked `experiment-repo` in `experiment-repo`#11 to confirm the appendix description against `src/gate/gnn.py`. I had first posted that request on the wrong repository's issue (`paper-repo`#11, already closed) and deleted it.
- **Next:** I have not opened the `main`→`release` pull request yet. I'll open it once `experiment-repo` confirms the GNN description.
